ticket.text: Los usuario en la subred 192.168.241.0 no puede llegar a la pagina principal de AWS, les da error de conectividad a traves del FortiGate

classification.rationale: The ticket describes connectivity issues from a specific subnet (192.168.241.0) to an external service (AWS) and explicitly mentions FortiGate, which is a firewall. This points primarily to network-level and firewall (network-security) problems; cloud is relevant because the destination is AWS. Unlikely to be auth, database, or hardware based on the information given.
